$meta.comment: Canonical Figma <-> code mapping (ADR-0010). Human-readable view: Architecture.md §3.1. Every entry's code file must carry `// figma: node-id=<nodeId>` in its header. Components are added here in the same PR that creates them (Phase 2+); nodeId values are looked up in Figma dev mode or via MCP at build time.
$meta.status: pre-Phase-2: paths reserved, nodeId filled in when each component is built

Atom/Button.notes: CVA variant=filled|outline|white|transparent|destructive (Figma 'Distructive'); Hover/Active are CSS states. 'With icon'/'With text' modelled as presence of the `icon`/`children` props; icon-only requires aria-label (type-enforced). Figma's Filled/Active instance has drifted padding (uniform 8px vs 4px/8px elsewhere) — treated as auto-layout drift, not modelled. Hover fill/stroke use the dedicated surface-hover / border-hover semantic tokens (added 2026-07-20; same stone-300/stone-500 primitives, named for their role).

Atom/Tag.notes: Figma 'Color' axis → semantic CVA variant: Grey→neutral, Red→urgent, Yellow→medium, Blue→mid, Green→low (matches card priority enum)

Atom/Input-field.notes: Figma 'Trekking-icon' is a misnomer for the TRAILING icon → code prop `trailingIcon`. 'Field'+'Title' → `label` (requires `id`, type-enforced, since an RSC cannot useId); 'Content' → native placeholder/value; 'Button' SLOT → `button` named slot (not a hardcoded Button instance, per CLAUDE.md). Only Hover differs from Default (border stone-300→stone-500); Active is identical to Default so no focus style is invented — the native input focus ring is left intact. NOT MODELLED: Figma's 'Text' bool can hide the whole input row, leaving only the button slot — meaningless for an input atom, flagged for triage. Placeholder and hover border use the dedicated text-placeholder / border-hover semantic tokens (added 2026-07-20; border-hover is shared with Atom/Button).

Checkbox.notes: Checked=No/Yes prop; fetched node has no 'delete' state — needs triage before a future ticket adds it (#16)

Icon/*.notes: single wrapper around lucide-react@1.25.0+ (upgraded 2026-07-20 for the Broccoli icon, added upstream between v1.14–1.15). Figma layer names are kept in sync with lucide export names (renamed 2026-07-20, refined same day: Clock→Alarm-clock-check, Cake→Cake-slice, List→Scroll, Folder→Folder-closed, Columns→Columns-3, Cross→X, Calandar typo fixed to Calendar) so IconName is a direct PascalCase lookup — every entry verified against rendered SVG structure, not name alone (caught 3 real bugs this way: Columns was previously mismapped to Columns2 — a 2-column/1-divider icon — when Figma's vector has 2 dividers = 3 columns; Cross was mapped by literal name to lucide's medical-cross glyph instead of X; the sidebar-panel icons (nodes 3629:126 / 3687:4453) went through an open/close label swap then a left/right correction — the app's sidebar sits on the left, so they're now 'Panel-left-close'/'Panel-left-open', matching the verified divider-at-x=9 geometry — both fixed 2026-07-20 by the user). No open discrepancies remain.

Dropdown.notes: Built #34. Single COMPONENT (no State/variant axis, unlike Input-field's component set). 'Field'+'Title' → `label` (requires `id`, type-enforced, same idiom as InputField); SLOT 'Slot' (always present, not gated by a bool) → required `children`. NOT MODELLED — flagged for design-side triage: `Step`, `Leading-icon`, `Trekking-icon` (= trailing) all exist in propertyDefinitions but are unbound to any layer in the fetched node (confirmed at fetch depth 15 and visually via download_figma_images — the rendered instance shows only the label + bordered Slot, no icon/step affordance) — same category of gap as InputField's unmodelled 'Text' bool; someone needs to wire these properties to real layers in Figma before a future ticket can model them. No hover/active override added (no State property exists on this component). role="group" + aria-labelledby chosen over role="listbox" since slot children are caller-supplied and not guaranteed role="option". Colours reuse existing tokens with no gap: white→surface, stone-300→border, stone-500→text-muted.

Button/Toggle.notes: added 2026-07-20 (was missing from initial map); props: Text, With text, With icon

Card.notes: Props Title (bool)+Text (text) -> `title?: string`; Step (bool) -> `step?: ReactNode` composed via the existing Step molecule instance (Figma nests a real Step instance here); SLOT 'Type' -> required `children`. No variant/state axis on the node (booleans + text only) so no CVA — clsx merges className, same as Step. No token gaps: heading #0C0A09->text, slot fill #FFFFFF->surface, slot stroke #D6D3D1->border, all existing tokens. The 'Stap + Card' frame's own 12px corner radius has no fill/stroke so it's a no-op and is not modelled.

Step.notes: 32x32 circular badge (radius 99px → rounded-full), bg stone-200 (surface-raised), text-sm/semibold stone-500 (text-muted). Figma files it under the Atoms 'Steps' frame, but this map is canonical (ADR-0010) so it lives in molecules/. Fetched node is a single COMPONENT with no variant/state axis — no CVA added, content via children.
